symptom: a requirement anchored at a page fed only by database data sources stays 'nothing to reach' in report traceability although a journey opened the page, because the documented journey-log record has no `pages` field
cause: the report-tests skill and the report tests/traceability help showed a five-field record; `pages` (and step, message, run, browserMs) existed only in the JourneyRecord comment, so the one proof for a page-only requirement was undiscoverable
insight: An input format documented by example is documented only as far as the example goes: a field missing from it does not exist for a reader. Pin the example to the parser with a test, and make the dead-end cell name the way out
